verdict: All23 hard checklist requirements have accepted-main evidence; only item24 optional formatting remains. Ready for parent closure; no claim of an exhaustive theoretical Worker fault Cartesian product.

items.requirement: 保留已开始流的异常路径；未发头且未销毁时，让 503 设置 `Retry-After: 1` 后进入正常错误响应出口，实际发送状态/JSON 并结束响应。
